case_title: JOEL DROTTS VS. BAY CITY PROPERTY MANAGEMENT ET AL

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,475.00 FILED BY DROTTS, JOEL AS TO DEFENDANT BAY CITY PROPERTY MANAGEMENT DOE, MONICA (BUILDING OWNER/LLC OWNER) ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-09-2016 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

REQUEST TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF DROTTS, JOEL ORDER FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-09-2016 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO SEP-13-2016 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF JOEL DROTTS AND DEFENDANT'S REPRESENTATIVE AL JOHNSON, OFFICE ADMINISTRATOR AT BAY CITY PROPERTY MANAGEMENT. ALSO PRESENT WAS DEFENDANT MONICA HUJAZI, SUED AS MONICA DOE. NO PROOF OF SERVICE FOR EITHER DEFENDANT, AND MR. JOHNSON & MS. HUJAZI WERE UNWILLING TO WAIVE SERVICE OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AT TODAY'S PROCEEDINGS. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).

NO APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF JOEL DROTTS OR DEFENDANTS BAY CITY PROPERTY MANAGEMENT OR MONICA HUJAZI, SUED AS MONICA DOE. NO PROOF OF SERVICE AS TO EITHER DEFENDANT. THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. JUDGE PRO TEM: DIANNE PEEBLES. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
